thread:
Priya (sec-eng): Quick sync: switching to split retention for security logs to reduce exposure. Proposal: 0-21d raw indexed, 22-540d pseudonymized (tenant-salted hashes), >540d cold encrypted blobs. Need RBAC + re-id flow decisions.

Liam (infra): 👍. Implementation idea: per-tenant salt blobs encrypted by CMK; keywrap service does KMS decrypt and returns salt only to ephemeral worker. No human sees plaintext salt.

Nora (SOC): For incidents, SOC needs fast pivots. Can we auto-approve reveals for active HIGH pagers (2h token)? Manual approvals slow triage.

Theo (forensics): We need epoch mapping for salt rotation so historical hashes can be resolved. Reveal request must include epoch selector or proxy should try matching epochs.

Priya (sec-eng): Field set: email, ipv4, mac, device_id, user_id will be pseudonymized. Truncate/display-only for usernames. I'll open Legal intake.

Legal Bot: Re-identification requires lawful purpose per event, approver identity, and audit trail. Attach field inventory and access patterns to intake.

Liam (infra): Flow sketch: 1) ticket created with purpose; 2) keywrap service validates ticket + ACL; 3) service decrypts salt blob via KMS; 4) ephemeral pod runs re-id query; 5) results stored to secure path with TTL; 6) immutable audit written.

deploy-bot: CI change: add pseudonymized index mapping and job for ephemeral re-id pods. Ticket INFRA-8672 opened for canary.

Nora (SOC): Autopolicy: if pager active AND incident ID present, SOC auto-approves for up to 2h. Must log approver and incident ID. Rate-limit reveals per incident.

Theo (forensics): Test cases: epoch rotation lookup, expired token attempts, failed-decrypt fallback (should return masked rows only), perf SLA: re-id should start within 10 minutes post-approval.

Priya (sec-eng): Action items: 1) post field inventory + rationale to Legal today; 2) Liam to PR keywrap IAM + CMK policy by Fri; 3) run staged canary next week INFRA-8672; 4) Nora to draft SOC runbook.

Liam (infra): I'll add audit ledger to immutable S3 with object-lock and include ticket id, approver, epoch, pod id, and query hash.

Nora (SOC): I'll add runbook snippet and approval criteria to incident playbook PR.

Theo (forensics): Tag me on the canary so we validate re-id flow.

Priya (sec-eng): Thanks — keep access narrow and fully audited. I'll post Legal ticket ref when ready. :lock:
